WHEREAS, on June 18,2018, the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming (City), entered into an
Agreement with the Cheyenne Animal Shelter/Services(CAS)to provide both animal control and
animal shelter services; and
WHEREAS, the City provides $505,000.00 to CAS to provide these services; and
WHEREAS, CAS is directed by a volunteer Board of Directors, which in turn hires a
President/CEO to oversee and manage daily operations; and
WHEREAS, a recent highly-publicized incident involving an animal attack on a staff
member, and a subsequent training exercise involving the same canine led toboth the canine's
euthanasia and allegations of animal abuse against the CAS President/CEO; and
WHEREAS, the CAS Board investigated thematter, and held atleast two lengthy executive
sessions to discuss thematter, and finally decided to suspend the President/CEO; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the Cityof Cheyenne has determined theCASBoard
has failed to take timely, appropriate action to resolve this situation.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, that the City Attorney be directed to give sixty (60) days’notice to CAS of its
intent toterminate the Agreement between the City and CASpursuant to Section 8(k)of the
Agreement.
